fixture.setup: Controlled preparation fixture: select existing wave 2/3/4/5, grant identical 420/180/90 funds, default Normal lives. No prior-wave income, damage or cooldown. Purchases/upgrades use production commands. No combat edits, direct hits, kills or clearance. Unspent currencies stay visible; these are opportunity-cost comparisons, not identical spend or fresh campaigns.

layouts.central: Production buildPositions coverage ranking; take first legal unused position.
layouts.spread: Same legal cells ranked by distance to alternating anchors (210,210),(750,330), ties original coverage ranking.

plans.sustain: One level-3 Sustained control Encryption, then two level-1 Firewalls.
plans.reach: One level-3 Chain reach Encryption, then two level-1 Firewalls.
plans.support: One Distributor, then ten level-1 Firewalls.
plans.control-support: One level-1 Encryption, one Distributor, then nine level-1 Firewalls.

evidence: 112 controlled wave/layout/plan/variant comparisons, repeated identically. Linear focus/coverage and sustain/reach pairs intentionally share the same linear builds. Activity counts are not causal attribution. Not player observations, difficulty or engagement validation.
